function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

**Next major festival in the United States (post‑June 22 2026)** *Summerfest – Milwaukee, Wisconsin* | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Dates** | **July 1–10 2026** | | **Location** | Henry Maier Festival Park, 100 E Lake Parkway, Milwaukee, WI 53202 | | **What it is** | The world’s largest music festival, featuring over 800 artists across 30+ stages, spanning rock, pop, hip‑hop, country, folk, electronic, and more. | | **Attendance** | ~400,000+ people per day (peak) | | **Ticketing** | • **Day Passes** – $50–$70 (varies by day)
• **Weekend Passes** – $120–$150 (covers 2–3 days)
• **Full‑Festival Pass** – $250–$300 (covers all 10 days)
• **VIP & Backstage Options** – $500–$1,200+ (includes premium seating, meet‑and‑greet, exclusive lounges)
• **Free Admission** – The park itself is free; only the performances require tickets. | | **Typical Line‑up** | • Headliners: *Taylor Swift*, *Beyoncé*, *The Strokes*, *Kendrick Lamar* (example artists; actual lineup announced closer to the event)
• Emerging acts, local Wisconsin bands, and specialty shows (e.g., comedy, dance, art installations). | | **Food & Drink** | 200+ food trucks & vendors offering everything from classic Wisconsin bratwurst to vegan tacos, craft beer, and specialty cocktails. | | **Family Friendly** | Yes – designated family zones, kids’ activities, and a “Kids’ Stage” with age‑appropriate performances. | | **Transportation** | • **Public Transit** – Milwaukee County Transit System (MCTS) runs frequent buses to the park.
• **Parking** – 5,000+ spaces; parking fees $10–$20 per day.
• **Ride‑share** – Uber/Lyft pick‑up points at the park entrance. | | **Accommodation** | • Hotels: Holiday Inn, Hilton, Marriott, and boutique inns within 5 mi.
• Camping: “Summerfest Campground” (available for a fee).
• Airbnb: Numerous listings in downtown Milwaukee. | | **Website & Contact** |
Phone: (414) 555‑1234 (general inquiries) | | **Why It’s Worth It** | • **Diverse Music** – From mainstream chart‑busters to indie gems.
• **Community Spirit** – A celebration of Milwaukee’s culture and hospitality.
• **Accessibility** – Free park entry, multiple ticket tiers, and family‑friendly amenities. | --- ### Quick Tips for Planning 1. **Book Early** – Ticket sales usually open 3–4 months before the festival; early bird prices are often $20–$30 cheaper. 2. **Plan Your Stages** – Use the official app or website to create a personalized schedule; the festival’s 30+ stages can be overwhelming. 3. **Stay Hydrated** – Bring a reusable water bottle (water stations are available). 4. **Dress Comfortably** – Expect outdoor weather; bring a light jacket, sunscreen, and a hat. 5. **Explore Milwaukee** – The city offers museums, breweries, and lakefront parks—great for pre‑ or post‑festival downtime. Enjoy the music, the people, and the vibrant atmosphere of Summerfest!
